import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[10:22]  # rows 11-22: expense lines
cats = {}
for _, r in exp.iterrows():
    cat, _, amt = r[0], r[1], r[2]
    cats[cat] = cats.get(cat, 0) + amt
for c, a in cats.items():
    print(f'{c:16s} {a:,.2f}')
print('-' * 26)
print(f'{\"TOTAL\":16s} {sum(cats.values()):,.2f}')
print()
print('Formula check: SUM(C11:C22) ->', sum(exp[2]))
